The '''Hythrope sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Aviles Prime]], [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], [[Hythrope IV]] and [[Oolidi]].
